svg.text: and 2.8 µm long, left to right,
40 µm² diode to DVDD: 2 P+ strips of
20 µm × 1 µm in an N-well held on
DVDD by the N+ guard ring round them
40 µm² diode from DVSS: 2 N+ strips of
20 µm × 1 µm in P-type silicon held on
DVSS by the P+ guard ring round them
secondary: the four resistors, the four diode strips
protected net, after the 110 Ω: metal 1 and 2; an unruled shape inside it is an opening
the four strips are the only diffusion on the protected net; contacts and vias are not drawn
DVDD and DVSS rings: stripes of metal 3 to 5 across the cell, beyond the bond pad; not drawn
primary: nearer the pad, left of this view
rail clamp and its diode: in the supply pads
